comparison.objective: Glue and hold a broken mug handle in alignment until the bond sets.
comparison.physical_skill: Nozzle placement, two-point alignment, stabilization, and timed holding; no threaded adjustment or locking.
comparison.success_condition: Glue on both patches; handle held within 6 mm/10 degrees on a still mug for 3 seconds; safe released final state.
comparison.reason: Tests adhesive application and mating-part alignment, not adjustable-component commissioning.
